title: Hearty Yeasty Indian Natto Paratha
description: A yeasty, crumbly, and indulgent Indian dish featuring natto, this paratha is a perfect blend of flavors and textures, and can be made gluten-free friendly.
instructions: Combine yeast, sugar, and warm water in a bowl, and let it sit for 5 minutes to activate the yeast.
Add gluten-free flour, salt, and ghee to the bowl, and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Cover the dough with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 4 equal parts, and roll out each part into a thin circle.
Place a tablespoon of natto in the center of each circle, and add some chopped coriander leaves and green chili on top.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a paratha, and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat, and cook the paratha for 2 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown.
Serve the paratha hot in a hot-pot vessel, with a squeeze of lemon juice on top.
